content.scenario: The President of the National Commission constitutes a monitoring cell to oversee the functioning of the State Commissions from an administrative point of view, and the monitoring cell reviews the pendency of cases in the State Commissions.
content.outcome: As per the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the functioning of the State Commissions is overseen from an administrative point of view by the monitoring cell constituted by the President of the National Commission.
